```{r Load Needed Libraries, include=FALSE}
install_if_missing <- function(package) {
  if (!require(package, character.only = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(package, dependencies = TRUE)
    library(package, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}

sapply(packages, install_if_missing)
rm(packages, install_if_missing)

#Check timezone
check_timezone <- function(site_timezone, intended_timezone = Sys.timezone()) {
  if (site_timezone != intended_timezone) {
    cat("Warning: You specified", site_timezone, "but your system time zone is", intended_timezone, "\n")
    response <- readline(prompt = "Was that intentional? (yes/no): ")
    
    if (tolower(response) %in% c("no", "n")) {
      new_timezone <- readline(prompt = "Please enter the correct timezone: ")
      cat("Timezone updated to", new_timezone, "\n")
      return(new_timezone)
    } else {
      cat("Proceeding with the originally specified timezone:", site_timezone, "\n")
      return(site_timezone)
    }
    
  } else {
    cat("Timezone is set to", site_timezone, "\n")
    return(site_timezone)
  }
}

#Time Zone Check
```

```{r Function to Convert Datetimes to Local Time Zone}
#Write Function to Convert Datetime Columns to 'UTC'
fn.timezone_tolocal <- function(df) {
  # Get the dataset schema
  sch <- df$schema
  #Which Fields are Datetime Types?
  datetime_fields <- keep(sch$fields, function(field) {
    grepl("^timestamp", field$type$ToString())
  })
  # Extract the names of these datetime columns
  datetime_cols <- map_chr(datetime_fields, "name")
  
  #Now Convert DateTime Columns to Local Timezone
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(datetime_cols), ~ cast(.x, arrow::timestamp("us", site_time_zone)))) |>
    compute()
}
```

```{r Define Study Months/Quarters}
#Further Define sex_category as female 1, male/other/unknown 0
rose_analytic_df <- rose_analytic_df |>
  mutate(female=fifelse(tolower(sex_category)=='female', 1, 0), 
         year=year(t_rose_first),
         calendar_month=month(t_rose_first)  
        ) |>
  arrange(year, calendar_month)

#Report Out Minimum and Maximum Times
cat('At', site, 'the first eligible patient was enrolled on', as.character(first(rose_analytic_df$t_rose_first)), 
    '\n and the last on', as.character(last(rose_analytic_df$t_rose_first)))

#Create a Study Month Data Frame to Merge to Create Study Month; Can Adjust ym() to accomadte desired period; for this analysis 2018 through 2025
study_month <- data.frame(start_date=seq(ym("201801"), ym("202512"), by= "months")) |>
  mutate(calendar_month=month(start_date)) |>
  mutate(year=year(start_date)) |>
  arrange(year, calendar_month) |>
  mutate(study_month=seq(1:n())) |>
  select(-start_date) |>
  mutate(study_quarter=ceiling(study_month/3))

#Now Merge to paralytics Analytic_DF
rose_analytic_df <- rose_analytic_df |>
  left_join(study_month) 
 
#Define the Pre-Specified Study Periods
#Jan 2018-Feb 2020 'Pre-ROSE/Pre-COVID', Mar 2020-Feb 2022 'Post-ROSE/COVID', Mar 2022-December 2025 'Post-ROSE/post-COVID'
rose_analytic_df <- rose_analytic_df |>
  filter(year<2026 & year>2017) |>
  mutate(study_period=fcase(
    study_month>=1 & study_month<27, 'Pre-ROSE/Pre-COVID',
    study_month>=27 & study_month<50, 'Post-ROSE/COVID',
    study_month>=50, 'Post-ROSE/Post-COVID'
  )) |>
  mutate(study_period_cat=factor(study_period,
                               levels = c("Pre-ROSE/Pre-COVID", "Post-ROSE/COVID", "Post-ROSE/Post-COVID"),
                               labels = c(0, 1, 2)))

#In this script we keep track of the minimum and maximum study month both for graphs and for the modelling
min_month <- min(rose_analytic_df$study_month, na.rm = T)
max_month <- max(rose_analytic_df$study_month, na.rm = T)
min_quarter <- min(rose_analytic_df$study_quarter, na.rm = T)
max_quarter <- max(rose_analytic_df$study_quarter, na.rm = T)

  distinct(study_period)

n_hospitals <- length(unique(rose_analytic_df$hospital_id[!is.na(rose_analytic_df$hospital_id)]))
```

```{r}
#Create a Table of N of Patients and Number paralytics  Per Study Month
paralytics_per_month <- rose_analytic_df |>
  group_by(study_month) |>
  summarise(
    'site' = site,
    'n_hospitals' = n_hospitals,
    'year' = mean(year),
    'calendar_month' = mean(calendar_month),
    'study_period' = max(study_period),
    'n_patients' = n(),
    'n_paralytics_12_hr' = sum(any_paralytic_12),
    'paralytics_12_hr_percent' = mean(any_paralytic_12),
    'standard_error_12' = sqrt(mean(any_paralytic_12) * (1 - mean(any_paralytic_12)) / n()),
    'n_paralytics_24_hr' = sum(any_paralytic_24),
    'paralytics_24_hr_percent' = mean(any_paralytic_24),
    'standard_error_24' = sqrt(mean(any_paralytic_24) * (1 - mean(any_paralytic_24)) / n()),
    'n_paralytics_48_hr' = sum(any_paralytic_48),
    'paralytics_48_hr_percent' = mean(any_paralytic_48),
    'standard_error_48' = sqrt(mean(any_paralytic_48) * (1 - mean(any_paralytic_48)) / n()),
    'n_paralytics_72_hr' = sum(any_paralytic_72),
    'paralytics_72_hr_percent' = mean(any_paralytic_72),
    'standard_error_72' = sqrt(mean(any_paralytic_72) * (1 - mean(any_paralytic_72)) / n()),
    'n_paralytics_all' = sum(any_paralytic_ever),
    'paralytics_percent_all' = mean(any_paralytic_ever),
    'standard_error_all' = sqrt(mean(any_paralytic_ever) * (1 - mean(any_paralytic_ever)) / n())
  ) |>
  relocate(site, n_hospitals, .before = study_month)

max_monthly_n <- max(paralytics_per_month$n_patients)


#Repeat Per Study Quarter, excluding post-OR patients

  group_by(study_quarter) |>

    'site' = site,
    'n_hospitals' = n_hospitals,
    'study_period' = max(study_period),
    'n_patients' = n(),
    'sars_cov2_positive' = sum(sars_cov2_positive=='Positive', na.rm=T),
```

```{r Visualize Paralytics Use Over Time}
#Create Labels for Study Quarter
quarter_labels <- c(
'2018:1-3', '2018:4-6', '2018:7-9', '2018:10-12',
'2019:1-3', '2019:4-6', '2019:7-9', '2019:10-12',
'2020:1-3', '2020:4-6', '2020:7-9', '2020:10-12',
'2021:1-3', '2021:4-6', '2021:7-9', '2021:10-12',
'2022:1-3', '2022:4-6', '2022:7-9', '2022:10-12',
'2023:1-3', '2023:4-6', '2023:7-9', '2023:10-12',
'2024:1-3', '2024:4-6', '2024:7-9', '2024:10-12', 
'2025:1-3', '2025:4-6', '2025:7-9', '2025:10-12')
study_quarter_labels <- quarter_labels[min_quarter:max_quarter]

#Now Repeat for Month
#Label Every 3rd Month
tool <- seq(min_month, max_month, by=2)
new_month_labels <- site_month_labels[tool]
 
paralytics_per_quarter<- left_join(paralytics_per_quarter, prone_per_quarter)
write_csv(paralytics_per_quarter, paste0(project_location, '/project_output_UPLOAD/', site,'_paralytics_per_quarter.csv'))

paralytics_per_quarter_per_hospital<- left_join(paralytics_per_quarter_by_hospital , prone_per_quarter_by_hospital )
write_csv(paralytics_per_quarter_per_hospital, paste0(project_location, '/project_output_UPLOAD/', site,'_paralytics_per_quarter_by_hospital.csv'))


#prone and paralytics per quarter - this is the main figure
base_plot <- ggplot(paralytics_per_quarter, aes(x=study_quarter)) +
  geom_line(aes(y=paralytics_48_hr_percent), color="blue") + 
  geom_line(aes(y=prone_48_hr_percent), color="red") + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = paralytics_48_hr_percent - standard_error_48, ymax = paralytics_48_hr_percent + standard_error_48), 
                width = 0.1, alpha = 0.5, color = 'grey') +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = prone_48_hr_percent - prone_standard_error_48, ymax = prone_48_hr_percent + prone_standard_error_48), 
                width = 0.1, alpha = 0.5, color = 'grey') +
  geom_point(aes(y=paralytics_48_hr_percent)) +
  geom_point(aes(y=prone_48_hr_percent)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0,1, by=0.1), 
                     labels = scales::percent, 
                     limits = c(0,1),
                     name = 'Paralyzed within 48 Hours of Meeting Study Criteria') +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(min_quarter, max_quarter, by=1),
                     labels = study_quarter_labels,
                     limits = c(min_quarter, max_quarter),
                     name = 'Year: Months') +
  theme_classic() + # theme_classic call
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1)) # custom x-axis text

#Now Add Annotations and Vertical Lines to Plot Based on What Data a Site Has Contributed
if (site_type == "Pre-ROSE/Pre-COVID,Post-ROSE/COVID,Post-ROSE/Post-COVID") {#If Site Has Full Study Period (2018-2025)
  extended <- base_plot +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 9, linetype = 2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 17, linetype = 2) +
    annotate("text", x=4.333333, y=0.95, label = 'Pre-ROSE \nPre-COVID') +
    annotate("text", x=13, y=0.95, label = 'Post-ROSE \nCOVID') +
    annotate("text", x=21.333333, y=0.95, label = 'Post-ROSE \nPost-COVID')
} else if (site_type == "Post-ROSE/COVID,Post-ROSE/Post-COVID") {
  extended <- base_plot + 
    geom_vline(xintercept = 9, linetype = 2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 17, linetype = 2) +
    annotate("text", x=13, y=0.95, label = 'Post-ROSE \nCOVID') +
    annotate("text", x=21.333333, y=0.95, label = 'Post-ROSE \nPost-COVID')
} else {
  extended <- base_plot
}

# Display the extended plot
extended
ggsave(paste0(site, '_prone_paralytics_by_quarter_48.pdf'),
       path = paste0(project_location, '/project_output_UPLOAD/'))
```

```{r alluvival plot}
#alluvial plot data
alluvial_data_long <- rose_analytic_df |>
  filter(!is.na(risk_factors_meet_criteria)  & !is.na(risk_factors_paralytic)) |>
  count(risk_factors_meet_criteria, risk_factors_paralytic) |>
  gather_set_data(1:2)  # converts to long format for ggforce

write_csv(alluvial_data_long, paste0(project_location, '/project_output_UPLOAD/', site,'_alluvial_numbers.csv'))

alluvial_data_long <- alluvial_data_long |>
  filter(n>10)

alluvial <- ggplot(alluvial_data_long, aes(x, id = id, split = y, value = n)) +
  geom_parallel_sets(aes(fill = risk_factors_meet_criteria), alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_parallel_sets_axes(axis.width = 0.15, fill = "grey80") +
  geom_parallel_sets_labels(colour = "black", size = 3, angle = 0,
                            hjust = 0.5 ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(
    title = "Flow from Risk Factor Criteria to Paralytic Agent",
    y = "Number of Patients",
    fill = "Risk Factor Criteria"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_blank()
  )

alluvial
ggsave(paste0(site, '_alluvial.pdf'),
       path = paste0(project_location, '/project_output_UPLOAD/'))
```

```{r TreeMap with pH - proning by prone time}
#Figure looking at breakdown of paralytics by hypoxemia/either_dysrony/proning/low pH, use imputed dyssynchrony measures - 48h proning
treemap_data<- rose_analytic_df %>% group_by(either_dys_impute, hypoxemia, ph_bad_cat) %>% mutate(total=sum(counter))
 
treemap_data<- treemap_data %>% mutate(risk_factors=case_when(hypoxemia==1 &  either_dys_impute==1 & ph_bad_cat==0~"Increased Respiratory Effort, Hypoxemia", hypoxemia==0 &  either_dys_impute==1 & ph_bad_cat==0~"Increased Respiratory Effort",  hypoxemia==1 &  either_dys_impute==0& ph_bad_cat==0 ~"Hypoxemia",hypoxemia==0 &  either_dys_impute==0 & ph_bad_cat==0~"None",  hypoxemia==1 &  either_dys_impute==1 & ph_bad_cat==1~"Increased Respiratory Effort, Hypoxemia, Low pH",  hypoxemia==0 &  either_dys_impute==1 & ph_bad_cat==1~"Increased Respiratory Effort, Low pH", hypoxemia==1 &  either_dys_impute==0& ph_bad_cat==1 ~"Hypoxemia, Low pH",  hypoxemia==0 &  either_dys_impute==0 & ph_bad_cat==1~"Low pH")) 

treemap_data<- treemap_data %>% group_by(risk_factors) %>% summarise(total=first(total))
treemap_data$cohort <- sum(treemap_data$total)
treemap_data$prop <- treemap_data$total / treemap_data$cohort
 
table(treemap_data$risk_factors, treemap_data$total, useNA = "always")
treemap(treemap_data, index = c("risk_factors"), vSize = "total", type="index", palette="Blues", title="All Patients", algorithm = "squarified")
write.csv(treemap_data, file=paste0(project_location, '/project_output_UPLOAD/', site, '_treemap_all_at_criteria_ph.csv'))
```

```{r Function to Summarise Logistic Regression Models}
model_summary_table <- function(model) {
 
#Uses Fixed Effects for Hospital in Sites with > 1 Hospital (and clustered standard errors)  
if (n_hospitals>1) {
  #Cluster Robust Standard Errors Using LM Test
  coef_table <- coeftest(model, 
                         vcovCL(model, cluster = model.frame(model)$hospital_id)) 
  # Cluster-robust covariance matrix
  clustered_se <- vcovCL(model, cluster = model.frame(model)$hospital_id)
  #Compute confidence intervals manually using the clustered SE
  conf_int <- coefci(model, vcov. = clustered_se)
}  else {
  coef_table <- coeftest(model)
  conf_int <- coefci(model)
}
 model_table <- data.frame(
  'site' = site,
  'n_observations' = nobs(model),
  'term' = rownames(coef_table),
  'estimate' = coef_table[, "Estimate"],
  'std_error' = coef_table[, "Std. Error"],
  'p_value' = coef_table[, "Pr(>|z|)"],
  'odds_ratio' = round(exp(coef_table[, "Estimate"]), 3),  # Exponentiated coefficients as Odds Ratios
  'lower_bound' = exp(conf_int[, 1]),  # Lower bound of CI from coefci()
  'upper_bound' = exp(conf_int[, 2])   # Upper bound of CI from coefci()
)
model_table <- model_table |>
  mutate(confidence_interval=paste0(round(lower_bound, 3), ' - ', round(upper_bound, 3))) |>
  mutate(n_hospitals=n_hospitals) |>
  relocate(confidence_interval, .before = lower_bound) |>
  relocate(n_hospitals, .after = n_observations) 
  rownames(model_table) <- NULL
return(model_table)
}
```

```{r Logistic Regression}
#To Aid In Intrepretability Plan to Scale Each of The Continuous Variables
#Will Use Global Mean from Preliminary Data to Center Each Variable and then Scale by Reasonable Delta
rose_analytic_df <- rose_analytic_df |>
  mutate(
    age_scale=(age_at_admission-60)/10,
    bmi_scale=(bmi-30)/5,
    first_rose_pf_all_scale=(first_rose_pf_all-100)/10,
    first_rose_fio2_scale=(first_rose_fio2-0.8)/.1 ,
    first_rose_peep_scale = (first_rose_peep - 10),
    compliance_scale = (compliance_estimate_min - 30)/5,
    compliance_scale_obs = (compliance_min - 30)/5,
    rr_diff_max_scale = rr_diff_max/5,
    rr_diff_max_scale_impute = rr_diff_max_impute/5,
    tv_cc_kg_scale = tv_cc_kg - 6,
    min_ph_scale = (min_ph - 7.4)/.1,
    mv_obs_max_scale = (mv_obs_max -10),

    plat_max_scale = (plat_estimate_max-20)/5, 
    plat_max_scale_obs = (plat_max-20)/5,
```

```{r}
          data = rose_analytic_df, 
          family=binomial)
} else {

model_form_step <- any_paralytic_48 ~    bmi_scale + age_scale + sofa_score_scale + race_ethnicity +  first_rose_fio2_scale + first_rose_peep_scale + criteria + first_rose_pf_all_scale + nee_pressor_dose + ett_to_enrolled + female  + enrollment_location_type  + deep_rass_max + rr_diff_max_scale + covid_positive + tv_cc_kg_scale  + mv_obs_max_scale  + plat_max_scale + compliance_scale+ prone_48
main_mod_ett <- glm(model_form_step,
          data = subset(rose_analytic_df, or_before_enrollment==0), 
          family=binomial, na.action = na.omit)
}

summary(main_mod_ett)
main_mod_summary_sa6 <- model_summary_table(main_mod_ett)
}

#SA4: Subset of patients IMV 2022-2024; Identifying predictors of paralytics within 48 hours, including estimated compliance and plateau pressure
if (n_hospitals>1) {
model_form_step <- any_paralytic_48 ~ factor(hospital_id) + bmi_scale + age_scale + sofa_score_scale + race_ethnicity + or_before_enrollment + first_rose_fio2_scale + first_rose_peep_scale +  criteria + first_rose_pf_all_scale + nee_pressor_dose + ett_to_enrolled + female  + enrollment_location_type  + deep_rass_max + rr_diff_max_scale + covid_positive + tv_cc_kg_scale  + mv_obs_max_scale  + plat_max_scale + compliance_scale+ prone_48
main_mod_current <- glm(model_form_step,
          data = subset(rose_analytic_df, t_rose_first>=as.POSIXct("2022-01-01", tz=site_time_zone)), 
          family=binomial)
} else {
model_form_step <- any_paralytic_48 ~ bmi_scale + age_scale + sofa_score_scale + race_ethnicity + or_before_enrollment + first_rose_fio2_scale + first_rose_peep_scale +  criteria + first_rose_pf_all_scale + nee_pressor_dose + ett_to_enrolled + female  + enrollment_location_type  + deep_rass_max + rr_diff_max_scale + covid_positive + tv_cc_kg_scale  + mv_obs_max_scale  + plat_max_scale + compliance_scale+ prone_48
main_mod_current <- glm(model_form_step,
          data = subset(rose_analytic_df, t_rose_first>=as.POSIXct("2022-01-01", tz=site_time_zone)), 
          family=binomial, na.action = na.omit)
}

summary(main_mod_current)
main_mod_summary_sa4 <- model_summary_table(main_mod_current)

  
#propensity score model  
if (n_hospitals>1) {
    model_form_step <- any_paralytic_48 ~ factor(hospital_id) +  or_before_enrollment + first_rose_fio2_scale + first_rose_peep_scale  + first_rose_pf_all_scale +  + deep_rass_max + rr_diff_max_scale   + mv_obs_max_scale  + plat_max_scale + compliance_scale + prone_48 + ph_bad_cat
    main_mod <- glm(model_form_step,
                    data = rose_analytic_df, 
                    family=binomial)
  } else {
    model_form_step <- any_paralytic_48 ~  or_before_enrollment + first_rose_fio2_scale + first_rose_peep_scale  + first_rose_pf_all_scale +  + deep_rass_max + rr_diff_max_scale   + mv_obs_max_scale  + plat_max_scale + compliance_scale + prone_48 + ph_bad_cat
    main_mod <- glm(model_form_step,
                    data = rose_analytic_df, 
                    family=binomial, na.action = na.omit)
  }
  
  summary(main_mod)
  propensity_summary <- model_summary_table(main_mod)


#Summary Table With All Models
main_table <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(site = c("Main model_proning")),
  main_mod_proning_summary,
  data.frame(site= c("Propensity score")),
  propensity_summary,
  data.frame(site = c("SA1: all paralytics during first IMV")),
  main_mod_summary_sa1,
  data.frame(site = c("SA2: only observed plateau pressure and compliance")),
  main_mod_summary_sa2,
  data.frame(site = c("SA3: severe ARDS")),
  main_mod_summary_sa3,
  data.frame(site = c("SA4: Current practice 2022-2024")),
  main_mod_summary_sa4,
  data.frame(site = c("SA5: Exclude DNI")),
  main_mod_summary_sa5,
  data.frame(site = c("SA6: Exclude post-OR")),
  main_mod_summary_sa6
)
# Write the table to a CSV file
write.csv(main_table, paste0(project_location, '/project_output_UPLOAD/', site, '_adjusted_models.csv'))
```

```{r Repeat analyses looking at just post-covid data}
    counts <- as.numeric(gsub("^\\s*([0-9]+)\\s*\\(.*", "\\1", .x))
    fifelse(!is.na(counts) & counts < 10 & counts > 0 & characteristic !="X...Hypoxemia" & characteristic != "X...Hypoxemia..Prone"& characteristic != "X...Increased.Respiratory.Effort" & characteristic != "X...Increased.Respiratory.Effort..Hypoxemia" & characteristic !="X...Increased.Respiratory.Effort..Hypoxemia..Prone" & characteristic != "X...Increased.Respiratory.Effort..Prone" & characteristic != "X...None" & characteristic != "X...Prone" & characteristic !="initial_paralytic_type...intermittent...." & characteristic != "X...Hypoxemia..Low.pH" & characteristic != "X...Increased.Respiratory.Effort..Hypoxemia..Low.pH" & characteristic != "X...Increased.Respiratory.Effort..Low.pH" & characteristic != "X...Low.pH" & characteristic != "X...Hypoxemia.1" & characteristic != "X...Hypoxemia..Low.pH.1" & characteristic != "X...Hypoxemia..Prone..Low.pH" & characteristic != "X...Increased.Respiratory.Effort.1" & characteristic != "X...Increased.Respiratory.Effort..Hypoxemia.1" & characteristic != "X...Increased.Respiratory.Effort..Hypoxemia..Low.pH.1" & characteristic != "X...Increased.Respiratory.Effort..Hypoxemia..Prone..Low.pH" & characteristic != "X...Increased.Respiratory.Effort..Low.pH.1" & characteristic != "X...Low.pH.1" & characteristic != "X...None.1" & characteristic != "X...Prone..Low.pH", "<10", .x)
  }))
write.csv(tab1_excel, file=paste0(project_location, '/project_output_UPLOAD/', site, '_Table1_by_Proning_current.csv'))

#Main Model: first look at primary outcome, identifying predictors of paralytics within 48 hours, including estimated compliance and plateau pressure 
if (n_hospitals>1) {
    model_form_step <- any_paralytic_48 ~ factor(hospital_id) +  bmi_scale + age_scale + sofa_score_scale + race_ethnicity + or_before_enrollment + first_rose_fio2_scale + first_rose_peep_scale + criteria + first_rose_pf_all_scale + nee_pressor_dose + ett_to_enrolled + female  + enrollment_location_type  + deep_rass_max + rr_diff_max_scale + covid_positive + tv_cc_kg_scale  + mv_obs_max_scale  + plat_max_scale + compliance_scale + prone_48
    main_mod <- glm(model_form_step,
                    data = current_analytic_df, 
                    family=binomial)
  } else {
    model_form_step <- any_paralytic_48 ~  bmi_scale + age_scale + sofa_score_scale + race_ethnicity + or_before_enrollment + first_rose_fio2_scale + first_rose_peep_scale + criteria + first_rose_pf_all_scale + nee_pressor_dose + ett_to_enrolled + female  + enrollment_location_type  + deep_rass_max + rr_diff_max_scale + covid_positive + tv_cc_kg_scale  + mv_obs_max_scale  + plat_max_scale + compliance_scale + prone_48
    main_mod <- glm(model_form_step,
                    data = current_analytic_df, 
                    family=binomial, na.action = na.omit)
  }
  
  summary(main_mod)
  main_mod_proning_summary <- model_summary_table(main_mod)

    
  #Next look at SA; 
  #Model SA1: look at paralytics within first IMV episode (not just 48h), including compliance and plateau pressure 
  if (n_hospitals>1) {
    model_form_step <- any_paralytic_ever ~ factor(hospital_id) +  bmi_scale + age_scale + sofa_score_scale + race_ethnicity + or_before_enrollment + first_rose_fio2_scale + first_rose_peep_scale + criteria + first_rose_pf_all_scale + nee_pressor_dose + ett_to_enrolled + female  + enrollment_location_type  + deep_rass_max + rr_diff_max_scale + covid_positive + tv_cc_kg_scale  + mv_obs_max_scale  + plat_max_scale + compliance_scale+ prone_48
    main_mod_sa1 <- glm(model_form_step,
                        data = current_analytic_df, 
                        family=binomial)
  } else {
    model_form_step <- any_paralytic_ever ~  bmi_scale + age_scale + sofa_score_scale + race_ethnicity + or_before_enrollment + first_rose_fio2_scale + first_rose_peep_scale + criteria + first_rose_pf_all_scale + nee_pressor_dose + ett_to_enrolled + female  + enrollment_location_type  + deep_rass_max + rr_diff_max_scale + covid_positive + tv_cc_kg_scale  + mv_obs_max_scale  + plat_max_scale + compliance_scale+ prone_48
    main_mod_sa1 <- glm(model_form_step,
                        data = current_analytic_df, 
                        family=binomial, na.action = na.omit)
  }
  
  summary(main_mod_sa1)
  main_mod_summary_sa1 <- model_summary_table(main_mod_sa1)
  
  #Model SA2: look at paralytics within first 48h, excluding estimated compliance and plateau pressure - use true values from observed plateau pressure
  if (n_hospitals>1) {
    model_form_step <- any_paralytic_48 ~ factor(hospital_id) +  bmi_scale + age_scale + sofa_score_scale + race_ethnicity + or_before_enrollment + first_rose_fio2_scale + first_rose_peep_scale + criteria + first_rose_pf_all_scale + nee_pressor_dose + ett_to_enrolled + female  + enrollment_location_type  + deep_rass_max + rr_diff_max_scale + covid_positive + tv_cc_kg_scale  + mv_obs_max_scale  + plat_max_scale_obs + compliance_scale_obs+ prone_48
    main_mod_sa2 <- glm(model_form_step,
                        data = current_analytic_df, 
                        family=binomial)
  } else {
    model_form_step <- any_paralytic_48 ~  bmi_scale + age_scale + sofa_score_scale + race_ethnicity + or_before_enrollment + first_rose_fio2_scale + first_rose_peep_scale + criteria + first_rose_pf_all_scale + nee_pressor_dose + ett_to_enrolled + female  + enrollment_location_type  + deep_rass_max + rr_diff_max_scale + covid_positive + tv_cc_kg_scale  + mv_obs_max_scale  + plat_max_scale_obs + compliance_scale_obs+ prone_48
    main_mod_sa2 <- glm(model_form_step,
                        data = current_analytic_df, 
                        family=binomial, na.action = na.omit)
  }
  
  summary(main_mod_sa2)
  main_mod_summary_sa2 <- model_summary_table(main_mod_sa2)
  
  #SA3: Subset of Severe ARDS; Identifying predictors of paralytics within 48 hours, including estimated compliance and plateau pressure, in patients with p/f<100
  if (n_hospitals>1) {
    model_form_step <- any_paralytic_48 ~ factor(hospital_id) +   bmi_scale + age_scale + sofa_score_scale + race_ethnicity + or_before_enrollment + first_rose_fio2_scale + first_rose_peep_scale +  criteria + first_rose_pf_all_scale + nee_pressor_dose + ett_to_enrolled + female  + enrollment_location_type  + deep_rass_max + rr_diff_max_scale + covid_positive + tv_cc_kg_scale  + mv_obs_max_scale  + plat_max_scale + compliance_scale+ prone_48
    main_mod_severe <- glm(model_form_step,
                           data = subset(current_analytic_df, severe_ards==1), 
                           family=binomial)
  } else {
    model_form_step <- any_paralytic_48 ~   bmi_scale + age_scale + sofa_score_scale + race_ethnicity + or_before_enrollment + first_rose_fio2_scale + first_rose_peep_scale + criteria + first_rose_pf_all_scale + nee_pressor_dose + ett_to_enrolled + female  + enrollment_location_type  + deep_rass_max + rr_diff_max_scale + covid_positive + tv_cc_kg_scale  + mv_obs_max_scale  + plat_max_scale + compliance_scale+ prone_48
    main_mod_severe <- glm(model_form_step,
                           data = subset(current_analytic_df, severe_ards==1), 
                           family=binomial, na.action = na.omit)
  }
  
  summary(main_mod_severe)
  main_mod_summary_sa3 <- model_summary_table(main_mod_severe)
  
  #SA5: Subset of patients who are okay with reintubation (exclude DNAR/DNI and DNI)
  if (n_hospitals>1) {
    model_form_step <- any_paralytic_48 ~ factor(hospital_id) + bmi_scale + age_scale + sofa_score_scale + race_ethnicity + or_before_enrollment + first_rose_fio2_scale + first_rose_peep_scale +  criteria + first_rose_pf_all_scale + nee_pressor_dose + ett_to_enrolled + female  + enrollment_location_type  + deep_rass_max + rr_diff_max_scale + covid_positive + tv_cc_kg_scale  + mv_obs_max_scale  + plat_max_scale + compliance_scale+ prone_48
    main_mod_ett <- glm(model_form_step,
                        data = subset(current_analytic_df, code_status_presume!="No resuscitation, no intubation" & code_status_presume !="Okay with resuscitation, except no intubation"), 
                        family=binomial)
  } else {
    model_form_step <- any_paralytic_48 ~ bmi_scale + age_scale + sofa_score_scale + race_ethnicity + or_before_enrollment + first_rose_fio2_scale + first_rose_peep_scale + criteria + first_rose_pf_all_scale + nee_pressor_dose + ett_to_enrolled + female  + enrollment_location_type  + deep_rass_max + rr_diff_max_scale + covid_positive + tv_cc_kg_scale  + mv_obs_max_scale  + plat_max_scale + compliance_scale+ prone_48
    main_mod_ett <- glm(model_form_step,
                        data = subset(current_analytic_df, code_status_presume!="No resuscitation, no intubation" & code_status_presume !="Okay with resuscitation, except no intubation"), 
                        family=binomial, na.action = na.omit)
  }
  
  summary(main_mod_ett)
  main_mod_summary_sa5 <- model_summary_table(main_mod_ett)
  
  
  #SA6: Subset of patients who are not post-procedure (no_or)
  if (n_hospitals>1) {
    model_form_step <- any_paralytic_48 ~ factor(hospital_id) +  bmi_scale + age_scale + sofa_score_scale + race_ethnicity +  first_rose_fio2_scale + first_rose_peep_scale +  criteria + first_rose_pf_all_scale + nee_pressor_dose + ett_to_enrolled + female  + enrollment_location_type  + deep_rass_max + rr_diff_max_scale + covid_positive + tv_cc_kg_scale  + mv_obs_max_scale  + plat_max_scale + compliance_scale+ prone_48
    main_mod_ett <- glm(model_form_step,
                        data = subset(current_analytic_df, or_before_enrollment==0), 
                        family=binomial)
  } else {
    model_form_step <- any_paralytic_48 ~    bmi_scale + age_scale + sofa_score_scale + race_ethnicity +  first_rose_fio2_scale + first_rose_peep_scale + criteria + first_rose_pf_all_scale + nee_pressor_dose + ett_to_enrolled + female  + enrollment_location_type  + deep_rass_max + rr_diff_max_scale + covid_positive + tv_cc_kg_scale  + mv_obs_max_scale  + plat_max_scale + compliance_scale+ prone_48
    main_mod_ett <- glm(model_form_step,
                        data = subset(current_analytic_df, or_before_enrollment==0), 
                        family=binomial, na.action = na.omit)
  }
  
  summary(main_mod_ett)
  main_mod_summary_sa6 <- model_summary_table(main_mod_ett)

#propensity score model  
if (n_hospitals>1) {
    model_form_step <- any_paralytic_48 ~ factor(hospital_id) +  or_before_enrollment + first_rose_fio2_scale + first_rose_peep_scale  + first_rose_pf_all_scale +  + deep_rass_max + rr_diff_max_scale   + mv_obs_max_scale  + plat_max_scale + compliance_scale + prone_48 + ph_bad_cat
    main_mod <- glm(model_form_step,
                    data = current_analytic_df, 
                    family=binomial)
  } else {
    model_form_step <- any_paralytic_48 ~  or_before_enrollment + first_rose_fio2_scale + first_rose_peep_scale  + first_rose_pf_all_scale +  + deep_rass_max + rr_diff_max_scale   + mv_obs_max_scale  + plat_max_scale + compliance_scale + prone_48 + ph_bad_cat
    main_mod <- glm(model_form_step,
                    data = current_analytic_df, 
                    family=binomial, na.action = na.omit)
  }
  
  summary(main_mod)

#Summary Table With All Models
main_table <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(site= c("main_model_proning")),
```

```{r SUPPLEMENTAL ANALYSES: Describe The Number of Admissions wrt Paralytics and Proning}
#######################################################################################

#######################################################################################

#Figure looking at breakdown of paralytics by hypoxemia/either_dysrony/proning, use imputed dyssynchrony measures
treemap_data<- rose_analytic_df %>% group_by(either_dys_impute, hypoxemia) %>% mutate(total=sum(counter))
treemap_data<- treemap_data %>% mutate(risk_factors=case_when( hypoxemia==1 &  either_dys_impute==1 ~"Increased Respiratory Effort, Hypoxemia",  hypoxemia==0 &  either_dys_impute==1 ~"Increased Respiratory Effort", hypoxemia==1 &  either_dys_impute==0 ~"Hypoxemia", hypoxemia==0 &  either_dys_impute==0 ~"None"))

treemap_data<- treemap_data %>% group_by(risk_factors) %>% summarise(total=first(total))
treemap_data$cohort <- sum(treemap_data$total)
treemap_data$prop <- treemap_data$total / treemap_data$cohort

table(treemap_data$risk_factors, treemap_data$total, useNA = "always")
treemap(treemap_data, index = c("risk_factors"), vSize = "total", type="index", palette="Blues", title="All Patients", algorithm = "squarified")
write.csv(treemap_data, file=paste0(project_location, '/project_output_UPLOAD/supplement/', site, '_treemap_all_at_criteria.csv'))

#Among those on paralytics
```

```{R Table 1}
  rownames_to_column('characteristic') |>

    }))

    fifelse(!is.na(counts) & counts < 10 & counts > 0 & characteristic !="X...Hypoxemia" & characteristic != "X...Hypoxemia..Prone"& characteristic != "X...Increased.Respiratory.Effort" & characteristic != "X...Increased.Respiratory.Effort..Hypoxemia" & characteristic !="X...Increased.Respiratory.Effort..Hypoxemia..Prone" & characteristic != "X...Increased.Respiratory.Effort..Prone" & characteristic != "X...None" & characteristic != "X...Prone" & characteristic !="initial_paralytic_type...intermittent...." & characteristic != "X...Hypoxemia..Low.pH" & characteristic != "X...Increased.Respiratory.Effort..Hypoxemia..Low.pH" & characteristic != "X...Increased.Respiratory.Effort..Low.pH" & characteristic != "X...Low.pH" & characteristic != "X...Hypoxemia.1" & characteristic != "X...Hypoxemia..Low.pH.1" & characteristic != "X...Hypoxemia..Prone..Low.pH" & characteristic != "X...Increased.Respiratory.Effort.1" & characteristic != "X...Increased.Respiratory.Effort..Hypoxemia.1" & characteristic != "X...Increased.Respiratory.Effort..Hypoxemia..Low.pH.1" & characteristic != "X...Increased.Respiratory.Effort..Hypoxemia..Prone..Low.pH" & characteristic != "X...Increased.Respiratory.Effort..Low.pH.1" & characteristic != "X...Low.pH.1" & characteristic != "X...None.1" & characteristic != "X...Prone..Low.pH", "<10", .x)
    }))
write.csv(tab1_excel, file=paste0(project_location, '/project_output_UPLOAD/supplement/', site, '_Table1_by_Proning.csv'))
rm(tab1_excel)
```

```{R CURRENT DATA}
#Figure looking at breakdown of paralytics by hypoxemia/either_dysrony/proning, use imputed dyssynchrony measures
treemap_data<- current_analytic_df %>% group_by(either_dys_impute, hypoxemia) %>% mutate(total=sum(counter))
treemap_data<- treemap_data %>% mutate(risk_factors=case_when( hypoxemia==1 &  either_dys_impute==1 ~"Increased Respiratory Effort, Hypoxemia",  hypoxemia==0 &  either_dys_impute==1 ~"Increased Respiratory Effort", hypoxemia==1 &  either_dys_impute==0 ~"Hypoxemia", hypoxemia==0 &  either_dys_impute==0 ~"None"))

treemap_data<- treemap_data %>% group_by(risk_factors) %>% summarise(total=first(total))
treemap_data$cohort <- sum(treemap_data$total)
treemap_data$prop <- treemap_data$total / treemap_data$cohort

table(treemap_data$risk_factors, treemap_data$total, useNA = "always")
```

```{r Last Piece Create a Table with Observed and Expected Paralytic Counts/Rates by Hospital and proning status}
#This Aggregate Data Will be Used for Risk and Reliability Adjusted Paralytic Rate Estimates by Hospital, study period
#Generate Paralytics Propensity Score (Don't Account for Hospital or study period Here)
alt_form <- any_paralytic_48 ~ or_before_enrollment + first_rose_fio2_scale + first_rose_peep_scale  + first_rose_pf_all_scale +  + deep_rass_max + rr_diff_max_scale   + mv_obs_max_scale  + plat_max_scale + compliance_scale  + ph_bad_cat + prone_48

alt_mod <- glm(alt_form,
               data = rose_analytic_df, 
               family=binomial)

#Collect Coefficient and Covariance Matrix for Centralized Creation of Global Coefficient
propensity_build_estimates <- model_summary_table(alt_mod)
propensity_build_covariance <- as.data.frame(vcov(alt_mod))

write.csv(propensity_build_estimates, paste0(project_location, '/project_output/', site, '_propensity_build_estimates.csv'))
write.csv(propensity_build_covariance, paste0(project_location, '/project_output/', site, '_propensity_build_covariance.csv'))

#Extract Dataset from Model
df <- alt_mod$data

#Propensity Score Taken from Prediction
df$paralytics_propensity <- predict(alt_mod, newdata=df, type = 'response')

#Each Site Aggregates Data
#Create Aggregate Dataset with Observed and Expected Events as well as N
df_agg <- df |>
  group_by(hospital_id) |>
  summarise(
    n_patients = n(),
    observed_paralytics = sum(any_paralytic_48, na.rm=TRUE),
    paralytics_rate_observed = mean(any_paralytic_48, na.rm=TRUE),
    paralytics_rate_adjust = mean(paralytics_propensity, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(!is.na(hospital_id)) |>
  mutate(expected_paralytics=round((paralytics_rate_adjust*n_patients), digits = 0)) |>
  mutate(not_paralytics=n_patients-observed_paralytics)

#Save CSV
write.csv(df_agg, paste0(project_location, '/project_output/', site, '_aggregate_expected_paralytics.csv'))
```
